name: FORCEFUL DEVOTION
source:
Calla, the beloved young queen of Deschi, has lived her entire life in selfless devotion to her country and people, until a chance encounter with a mysterious academic named Jasmine reveals a long-held secret of the royal bloodline--and brings out Calla's hidden desires. Caught between modern intrigue and ancient conspiracy, will Calla be able to seize her own destiny?
